rumors.text: A market crash right before the Nov 3 midterms will hurt Republicans and trigger a Democratic sweep
rumors.why: Election-linked political speculation; if a sweep scared markets it could pressure tech and AI names, but it is a vague single-user claim.

plays.reason: Fear and greed at 29 and a one-sided tech-led drop; traders watch 757-760 as support and the crowd is split about 50/50.

readings.whats_new: SPY slipped a little further to about -1.3% (759.37) and VIX rose to 18.9 from 17.0, with fear and greed down to 29. Stocktwits SPY score eased to 63 from 66, still about 50/50 bullish. Intel, Reddit and crypto-linked names remain the heavy losers, and chatter is now about the Nov 3 midterms.
